title: BambooToken: The Malware That Speaks MQTT to Stay Under the Radar

BambooToken: The Malware That Speaks MQTT to Stay Under the Radar. Researchers at SecurityAffairs detail a new malware strain that uses the MQTT IoT messaging protocol for command-and-control communication, blending in with legitimate IoT traffic to avoid detection. https://securityaffairs.com/199205/malware/bambootoken-the-malware-that-speaks-mqtt-to-stay-under-the-radar.html
